payload.name: Opening-1
payload.sigma_reason: Declared layout tolerance for the Opening-1 setting-out point. Design-declared, not a field resection, and not traceable to a standard.

note: Example bind against validation/cse-point-bind-v1.schema.json. Not field evidence. A gat.harness --commit digest cannot stand in for this record, and neither can a JSON object that only carries the schema name. Earlier versions of this file declared claim_scope identity-bind-only and no sigma, which the validator that defines this schema refused -- the repository's own example of cse-point-bind-v1 was not one.

omitted_on_purpose.world_digest: A world digest is local to one machine and one path spelling (docs/digest-portability-v1.md), so a shipped example cannot carry one that is true anywhere else. A bind written on site records it; this one names the world by citing the demo model instead.
omitted_on_purpose.receipt_digest: Left out rather than invented. A receipt digest that points at no receipt is worse than an absent field, and identity is a different hole from evidence.as_built in any case.
